series.name: THE RECEIPTS
series.tagline: One business-of-tech story in sixty seconds, with the receipts.

episodes.title: Microsoft 365 went dark for almost a full day. The bug had been hiding since July.

receipts.text: Outage from 11:20 AM ET Nov 12 to 11:10 AM ET Nov 13, 2026 (23 h 50 m of impact), worldwide; Outlook, Exchange Online, Teams, Copilot affected
receipts.source: Microsoft preliminary PIR (11/15/26) via BleepingComputer and Next.ink copy

receipts.text: Bug introduced in July 2026 in an update to Microsoft 365 networking gateway servers; ran more than three months without issue
Teams failed over to the gateway used by Exchange Online about 15 hours before the outage (01:07 UTC vs 16:20 UTC)
receipts.source: BleepingComputer; Data Studios timeline of the PIR

receipts.text: Nearly 14% of gateway capacity already offline (unrelated); more than 80% of servers unresponsive at worst; spread across the fleet in under two hours
Load testing missed it: lab hardware weaker than production; bug worse on newer, higher-core hardware
Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint could switch to alternative infrastructure and recover sooner; Exchange Online could not ('for scale reasons')
receipts.source: BleepingComputer; Office Watch reproduction of the PIR

episodes.title: Nvidia lost its founder. Then it posted its biggest quarter ever.

receipts.text: Board accepted Jensen Huang's resignation as President, CEO and director on Nov 11, 2026; Colette Kress (EVP & CFO) named interim CEO; Harvey C. Jones named chair

receipts.source: NVIDIA CEO transition release, Nov 12, 2026 (Kress quote)

receipts.text: Shares fell about 10% in premarket trading on the news
Q3 FY27 (ended Oct 25, 2026) revenue $115.8B, up 103% y/y from $57.0B; reported Nov 17, 2026
Highest quarterly revenue on record: Q3 FY26 $57.0B, Q4 FY26 $68.1B, Q1 FY27 $81.6B, Q2 FY27 $96.2B, Q3 FY27 $115.8B
receipts.source: NVIDIA Q4 FY26, Q1 FY27 and Q3 FY27 results releases

receipts.text: Data Center revenue $107.6B, about 93% of total; remainder (Edge Computing: PCs, gaming, automotive, robotics) $8.2B
receipts.source: NVIDIA Q3 FY27 results release; segment definition per Credence Research summary

receipts.text: Q4 FY27 outlook $130.0B plus or minus 3%, quarter includes an additional week, no China Data Center compute revenue assumed
